nodes.label: FluxBoard Keyboard Overview

nodes.label: Offline-First Design Principle
nodes.author: uncoalesced
nodes.rationale: Everything works offline; typing never touches network; zero telemetry enforced in CI.

nodes.label: ADR 0001 Split Large Source Files
nodes.author: uncoalesced
nodes.rationale: Split Kotlin files over 500 lines along natural seams to decouple JVM testability from Android.

nodes.label: Prediction Subsystem Architecture
nodes.author: uncoalesced
nodes.rationale: MappedByteBuffer duplicated cursors avoid corruption in concurrent lookups; weighted edit costs by key geometry.

nodes.label: Verifiable Build-Time Privacy Verification
nodes.author: uncoalesced
nodes.rationale: Unpack release APK DEX files and fail build if Play Services or telemetry SDKs are present.

nodes.label: Single IME Panel Height System
nodes.author: uncoalesced
nodes.rationale: rememberImePanelHeight ensures switching modes never resizes the IME window.

nodes.label: IME Service Compose Lifecycle Hosting
nodes.author: uncoalesced
nodes.rationale: IME is a Service, not Activity; lifecycle and viewModelStore owners must be installed on window.window.decorView.

nodes.label: Privacy Gates and Incognito State

nodes.rationale: IncognitoState singleton gates learning, clipboard capture, and sensitive fields.
